states.title: States
states.description: Which state license rolls to search. Covered: WA (Labor & Industries), OR (CCB), TX (TDLR trades), NY (DOL Contractor Registry).

licenseNumbers.title: License numbers
licenseNumbers.description: Look up specific license or certificate numbers.

businessNames.title: Business names
businessNames.description: Business or owner name contains this text (case insensitive). Up to 20.

trades.title: Trades
trades.description: Keyword matched against the license type and specialty, e.g. ELECTRICAL, PLUMBING, ROOFING, HVAC, A/C, GENERAL, RESIDENTIAL. Texas defaults to construction trades when empty.

cities.title: Cities
cities.description: Business city, e.g. SEATTLE, PORTLAND, AUSTIN.

issuedWithinDays.title: Newly licensed within (days)
issuedWithinDays.description: Only licenses issued in the last N days (new contractor leads). 0 = any date. Texas publishes no issue date and is skipped when this is set.

activeOnly.title: Active only
activeOnly.description: Skip expired, suspended and revoked licenses where the state publishes status.

requirePhone.title: Require phone
requirePhone.description: Only licenses with a phone number on file.

maxRows.title: Max licenses
maxRows.description: Cap on rows returned, split evenly across states. Controls cost.
